{{Top|leg}}
'''Kavaan''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] in the religious pantheon of the of the [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Also known as the Provider of the Sun, Kavaan was central to the religion as he allowed [[Kavaan'oa]], [[Shalyvane]]'s [[Star/Legends|sun]], to rise and set twice a day. Em'liy would pray and make blood sacrifices at a large stone altar to him at the center of the [[Circle of Kavaan/Legends|Circle of Kavaan]].<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
